author: Alison Schul
text: Those are so cute! I make my own by sublimating designs on Hypafix. We have a ton of it leftover from when my husband needed it for a wound and it's the only adhesive that doesn't make me break out into a rash. I wanted patches with raccoons on them and couldn't find any so I made my own!

author: Jennifer Carey
text: Turf tape is my favorite tape to use for patches
